summary: The roughly 1.5-acre 'social centerpiece' of the Pier 70 open-space network (D4D Section 3.9): Market Square (flanked by rehabilitated buildings and new construction, with an opening on 21st Street between Building 2 and Parcel D and a passageway through Buildings 2 and 12), the Building 12 entry plaza south of Building 12, a Maryland Street platform for vendors and food trucks, and possibly the retained structural frame of Building 15. Building 12 itself reopened in 2022 and Maryland Street's paving is done, but the plaza is a Phase 1 park still tied to adjacent vertical development.

milestones.text: Port Commission approves the Pier 70 project (Item 12B: 'On September 26, 2017, the Port Commission approved a mixed-use development project'). DDA terms as proposed in the Sept 22, 2017 staff report (Item 9B): parks completed 12-18 months after adjacent buildings, with Port Commission approval of the parks' schematic design

Building 15 lifted and moved from its temporary location to its permanent location over the newly built 22nd Street during Phase 1 infrastructure work. The Port's June 2025 deck lists this under 'Phase 1 Infrastructure Completed - 2018 - 2020' without a year, and the Port's Aug 2026 report says 22nd Street surface improvements began in March 2019, so a move over the 'newly built' street before 2019 is unlikely; the year shown is the earliest consistent with both and is approximate

Building 12 receives its temporary certificate of occupancy; the plaza area around it hosts interim activations (Paint the Void retrospective inside Building 12, roller rink under Building 15 in 2021)
Streets around Pier 70, including Maryland Street with specialty pavers and gingko trees, opened to the public
Building 12 Preview Party, a two-day community event with all Building 12 tenants

Port reports that although Phase 1 horizontal infrastructure and Building 12's rehabilitation are complete, construction of the balance of Phase 1, 'largely comprised of the Phase 1 parks and open space,' will be built 'on a schedule that coincides with the delivery of adjacent vertical development,' which 'has not moved forward' because of pandemic-driven office-vacancy increases, construction-cost escalation and higher financing costs

facts.value: 3.9 'Building 12 Plaza and Market Square', zone 5 of Figure 3.4.1

Market Square (flanked by rehabilitated buildings and new construction on three sides, four access ways, a compact tree grove), Building 12 Entry Plaza south of Building 12 (the building also has an entrance from 22nd Street), Maryland Street Platform, and the Building 15 structural frame pending a structural feasibility study
A pedestrian opening on 21st Street between Building 2 and Parcel D; the existing passageway through Buildings 2 and 12; a Building 12 entrance from 22nd Street; a direct entry from Maryland Street
Open-air markets, community gatherings, small performances; Market Square extends Maryland Street with coordinated paving to accommodate vendors and food trucks

Phase 1 park: Port Item 9B (2017, Table A) lists Building 12 Plaza (OS-1) and Market Square (OS-2) among the Phase 1 parks, and Port Item 11A cites three acres of Phase 1 parks overall. Item 11A's 2026 phasing plan (Exhibit A) is an image that could not be read as text, so this record does not state the plaza's place in the proposed 2026 phasing

open_questions: No completion date can be stated for the plaza. The Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) gives the Building 12 Plaza (OS-1) a park outside date of '1 year after Temporary Certificate of Occupancy (“TCO”) for Buildings 2 and 12' and Market Square (OS-2) '1 year after TCO for Building D' (Port Item 9B, Sept 22, 2017, Table A, p.8), and 9B says 'Parks must be completed between 12-18 months after completion of adjacent buildings' (p.7). Building 12's rehabilitation was completed in January 2022 (Port Item 11A, Aug 2026), but none of the sources cited here reports a TCO for Building 2 or Building D, and Item 11A says 'construction of Phase 1 vertical projects and parks has not moved forward' and that 'Developer has not exercised an option of any Phase 1 option parcels', so no calendar date follows. The DDA's Phase 3 outside date does not apply to this Phase 1 park, and the DDA's outside dates are extended while the down market delay lasts (extended to December 26, 2026); Item 11A also proposes to 'better align open spaces with revised vertical development schedule'.

No Port Commission schematic design approval or construction record for Market Square or the entry plaza was found; the interim events documented by the Port took place inside Building 12 and under Building 15, not on a finished plaza.

Whether the Building 15 structural frame is being retained (the D4D marks it 'pending structural feasibility study'): the Port's June 2025 deck shows Building 15 relocated over 22nd Street but does not say what will remain of it.

No openly licensed or public-record post-rehabilitation photo of Building 12 was found (checked Wikimedia Commons -- geosearch, category and title search all came up empty for anything dated 2022 or later). Perkins&Will's Building 12 wayfinding photography (by Bruce Damonte, via DNCO's case study) and Pier 70's own project photography are copyrighted, but their press/media contacts may grant editorial, non-commercial clearance on request -- worth revisiting if someone follows up with them.
